title: Java Developer
content_clean:
Are you excited to keep up-to-date with new algorithms and care about implementing them as efficiently as possible? Do you like to integrate different data sources in a Java application with a SQL database backend and to develop an innovative B2B software solution? Are you ready to take on a new challenge and join a fast growing and leading Swiss PropTech startup with ambitious plans to grow internationally? Then apply now and join us on our mission to improve the place where employees spend most of their days – the workspace.

WHO WE ARE

We are Locatee, a Zurich-based startup creating the future of office buildings. Our big data platform “Locatee Analytics” augments the physical workspace with real-time data to create smart and people-oriented office buildings. Thanks to Locatee, large worldwide organisations are able to intelligently optimise their office buildings and shape the way how people interact with their workspace.

These will be your tasks:

Maintain and further develop the backend of Locatee Analytics

Implement data analytics and aggregations

Develop integrations for different data sources, for example Exchange Web API for the workspace analytics

Ensure the software we ship runs stable and meets our customer’s quality standards

Employ simple design and pragmatic implementation techniques to drive business value

Code reviews to verify that the implementation meets specifications and designs using best practices

Mentor junior team members to progress their technical and profession skills. Be open and actively seek learning opportunities from senior team members.

Contribute your own ideas in our agile development process

You're offering these qualifications:

Java: Advanced skills with Java and JEE

Experience with Spring Framework, Messaging, Security, Web

Spring Data, Hibernate, JPA, transaction management

SQL and MySQL/MariaDB

Experience working with Git

Willing to learn and continuously working on improving your skills

Team player, entrepreneurial mindset

Excellent communications skills in English (written and spoken)

Additional skills are welcome, such as:

Experience with performance tuning, both in Java and SQL

Experience with messaging frameworks

Background in statistics and machine learning

Experience with networks (Switching, Routing, Wireless, SNMP)

Linux administration experience

We're offering these benefits:

Be part of a dynamic, fast-paced and internationally growing startup

Work on cutting-edge big data analytics technology for the largest organisations worldwide

A real scale-up adventure with great rewards

Through a flat organisation we encourage innovation, ownership and open communication so that everybody feels engaged in the dynamic of the group

A lot of independence and responsibility

An inspiring and modern working environment in Zurich

The ability to choose your own work devices

The chance to work in a young, ambitious and talented team where friendship is one of the company's values

We live diversity and speak 12 different languages (English being our company language)

Weekly team events, after-work beers and much more, we never miss out on fun!

Fresh fruits basket, homemade cakes, free tea, coffee & snacks

We're really much looking forward to being in touch with you!

title: Lead Data Architect
content_clean:
Headquartered in Lachen near Zurich, Switzerland, the Octapharma Group is a leading company in the worldwide market for therapeutic human proteins. Working at Octapharma means to have an opportunity to contribute to our common goal – developing lifesaving therapies to improve patients’ lives.

We are seeking

A highly motivated professional to join the corporate IT team as Lead Data Architect. In this newly created position, you will lead the implementation of the new data platform in Octapharma group. You will work together with an international team of business and IT team members on delivering high value data use cases.

Your main responsibilities and opportunities

Define the future data architecture, technical framework, and data governance

Collaborate and coordinate with multiple departments, stakeholders, partners, and external vendors

Translate business requirements into technical specifications, including data streams, integrations, transformations, databases, data lakes, ML, and data warehouses

Ensure that solutions exhibit high levels of performance, security, scalability, maintainability, appropriate reusability, and reliability upon deployment

Your Profile

Enterprise-scale technical experience with cloud and hybrid infrastructures, architecture designs, data models and technology management

Breadth of technical experience and knowledge, with deep subject matter expertise in some of the following areas:

Data Platform

Cloud solutions

SQL, Azure SQL

NoSQL data bases (Cosmos DB)

Big Data and Data Warehouses including Azure Analytics,

Advanced Analytics including Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Bricks, visualization tools as PowerBI, Qlik

Data Science

Machine Learning including Azure ML, ML Server, Python

Artificial Intelligence

Bachelor or master’s degree in computer science, information technology, or related field

Previous 5+ years’ experience in data architecture and data science.

You bring a drive for excellence and a positive “can do” approach.

Our offer

Develop and grow a professional career in and exiting, challenging and international environment

A responsible and varied job with active participation in the highly complex IT landscape

And attractive salary and benefits package

A skilled, motivated and committed team

How to apply

Please apply online in English describing your interest, expected salary, and enclosing your CV, references and/or recommendation letters.

title: Product Manager - Technical, B2B, SaaS
content_clean:
Are you a product person, tech savvy and ready for a new challenge in a leading Swiss PropTech start-up with global growth track-record? Then apply now and become part of our mission!

Locatee is the leading workplace analytics solution that transforms complex data into space utilisation insight. Developed with a strong focus and a deep understanding of the corporate real estate challenges facing the modern world of work, Locatee empowers companies to make decisions about your business buildings with confidence.

We are looking for a Technical Product Manager who will take a leading role in further enhancing and building our workplace analytics solution. You will be responsible for the data ingestion and processing components of our application.

The ideal candidate has a computer science degree and moved from a software development role to product management.

What you will do

Interact with external and internal stakeholders to identify functional and technical requirements for new feature developments

Work closely with the Head of Product & Head of Engineering in driving the company vision forward

Take the Product Owner responsibility in the Platform Scrum team

Create and maintain a product roadmap based on user needs, business requirements and technical constraints

Develop an appropriate business case to justify development efforts

Communicate product benefits to customers (product demonstrations) and to internal stakeholders

Define high quality user stories, feature specifications and prioritize the backlog (constantly iterate and measure)

Support in designing and executing PoC

Work closely with the development team to manage product life-cycle from concept to delivery.

What you bring

Proven history of successful SaaS product management: from product discovery to agile development and delivery

Ability to move from high-level strategy to detailed execution

You have a very good understanding of web product development and architectures, ideally some experience with Java, SQL and Cloud-native technologies

A basic understanding of common Data Science techniques, in particular Machine Learning, and the high-level technical requirements/trade-offs involved

Experience managing technical products or willingness to learn

BA/BSc (MSc preferred) in Computer Science, IT, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Data Science - or equivalent experience

Demonstrated ability to achieve strategic goals in a fast-paced environment, and to evolve product strategy based on research, data and industry trends

You have a team centric attitude

Good analytical and organizational skills, with proven ability to take initiatives

Excellent communication and presentation skills in English (written and spoken). German is a plus

Valid Swiss work permit or EU passport

Why you should work with us

The chance to work in an English-speaking office with room to grow in a dedicated, passionate, expert and experienced team that cares for each other

Work on cutting-edge big data analytics technology for the largest organisations worldwide

A real scale-up adventure with great rewards: we offer Phantom Stock Options to be part of Locatee’s success

Through a flat organisation we encourage innovation, ownership and open communication so that everybody feels engaged in the dynamic of the group

A lot of independence and responsibility

An inspiring and modern working environment in Zurich (you'll love our plants & trees, the hammock, standing desks, quiet zones, couches,...)

The ability to choose your own work devices

We live diversity

Optimise you work-life balance and work one week per year from wherever you want

Continuous learning through our Locatee Academy

Regular team events, after-work beers and much more, we never miss out on fun!

Fresh fruits basket, homemade cakes, free tea, coffee & snacks

Who we are

We are a Zurich-based start-up that supports large companies in optimizing their office buildings. Our Smart Building platform "Locatee " provides real-time data that makes office buildings intelligent and user-oriented. Thanks to Locatee, large organisations worldwide are able to intelligently optimize their office buildings and shape the way how people interact with their workspace.

Our motto is to create a work environment where people love to work. This is not only our working culture but also what we want our customers to reach thanks to Locatee.

Our fantastic diverse team consists of 30+ people with strong background in Product, Computer & Data science, Business Development, Marketing and Human Resources.

Basel

80-100%

Stellenantritt:

01.04.2019 oder nach Vereinbarung

Motiviert, leistungsfähig und veränderungsbereit. So sind die Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter der Basler Kantonalbank. Die Basler Kantonalbank, die untrennbar mit Basel verbunden ist und sich für eine lebenswerte und wirtschaftlich erfolgreiche Region engagiert.

Stellenbeschreibung
Die neugeschaffene Gruppe „Data Analytics“ innerhalb des Bereichs Digitale Marktleistungen verantwortet die Entwicklung und Umsetzung der strategischen Data Analytics Roadmap im Konzern Basler Kantonalbank. Zur Ergänzung des Teams suchen wir eine engagierte, innovationsfreudige und fachlich erfahrene Persönlichkeit als Data Scientist mit Schwerpunkt Analytics (w/m). In dieser interessanten und abwechslungsreichen Funktion liegt der Fokus auf Analytics und Machine Learning. In diesem Zusammenhang sind Sie für die folgenden Aufgaben verantwortlich:

Erfassung der Businessanforderungen und Definition des Datenbedarfs

Pilotierung von Datentransformation und -aufbereitung

Modellierung von strukturierten und unstrukturierten Daten

Text Mining

Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von Machine Learning Modellen, entsprechende Operationalisierung sowie Modellmonitoring

Begleitung von externen Data Scientisten und Review von extern entwickelten Analysen und Modellen

Dokumentation, Präsentation und Diskussion von Analyseresultaten mit internen Kunden

Projektmitarbeit und fachliche Verantwortung für Data Science Projekte

Anforderungsprofil

Abgeschlossenes Masterstudium in Data Science, Informatik, Statistik, Mathematik oder quantitativen Wirtschaftswissenschaften mit starkem analytischem Hintergrund

Breites Data Science Know-how mit mindestens drei Jahren Berufserfahrung im Bereich analytischer Fragestellungen, Erfahrung im Finanzdienstleistungssektor von Vorteil

SQL-Kenntnisse, Programmierkenntnisse in Python und/oder R

Hohe Methodenkompetenz und Umsetzungsstärke, vernetztes Denken sowie zuverlässige, systematische und selbständige Arbeitsweise

Ausgeprägte Eigeninitiative, Kreativität und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team

Bereitschaft neue Technologien zu lernen und umzusetzen

Stilsicheres Deutsch und gute Sprachkenntnisse in Englisch

Fachliche Auskünfte

Herr Pascal Freudiger, Fachspezialist Zielkundenmanagement, Tel. 061 266 32 89

Kontakt

Frau Sandra Ankli, Personalverantwortliche, Tel. 061 266 33 42

Motivated, high-performing, and open to change. These are the qualities of the employees at Basler Kantonalbank. The Basler Kantonalbank, which is inseparably linked to Basel, is committed to a livable and economically successful region.

Job Description
The newly established "Data Analytics" group within the Digital Market Services division is responsible for developing and implementing the strategic Data Analytics roadmap across the Basler Kantonalbank group. To strengthen the team, we are looking for an engaged, innovative, and experienced professional as a Data Scientist with a focus on Analytics (m/f). In this interesting and varied role, the focus is on Analytics and Machine Learning. In this context, you will be responsible for the following tasks:

- Gathering business requirements and defining data needs
- Piloting data transformation and preparation
- Modeling structured and unstructured data
- Text mining

Designing and Implementing Data Solutions: Utilize Azure data services to design and implement scalable data architectures. This includes setting up and maintaining Azure Data Lakes, Azure SQL Databases, and Azure Synapse Analytics.
Data Integration and Management: Develop ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes using Azure Data Factory to integrate data from various sources, ensuring data quality and consistency across the manufacturing process.
Real-Time Data Processing: Employ Azure Stream Analytics for real-time data processing, enabling immediate insights and actions based on manufacturing data streams.
Building Predictive Models: Use Azure Machine Learning to build and deploy predictive models that help optimize manufacturing processes and predict outcomes, enhancing decision-making capabilities.
Ensuring Data Compliance and Security: Implement and maintain data security and compliance measures in line with pharmaceutical industry regulations, utilizing Azure's security features.
Collaboration and Training: Work closely with IT and manufacturing teams to integrate and optimize data solutions. Provide training to staff on new data tools and processes.

Who are you?

Educational Background: A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.
Azure Expertise: Proven experience with Microsoft Azure data services (Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Azure SQL Database, etc.) and Azure certifications (such as Azure Data Engineer Associate) are highly desirable.
Data Engineering Experience: At least 3 years of experience in data engineering, with a focus on data integration, data warehousing, and ETL processes.
Knowledge in Machine Learning: Familiarity with machine learning concepts and experience using Azure Machine Learning to build and deploy models.
